usage: llm-modelbench simulate repair-watch [-h]
                                            [--scenario {capability-repair,needle-current,kv-cascade,interrupted-child,failed-child}]
                                            [--speed SPEED]
                                            [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                                            [--run-id RUN_ID] [--write-only]
                                            [--cleanup]
                                            [--screen {auto,normal,scroll}]
                                            [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --scenario {capability-repair,needle-current,kv-cascade,interrupted-child,failed-child}
  --speed SPEED         seconds between deterministic status transitions; 0
                        runs immediately
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR
  --run-id RUN_ID       stable fixture campaign directory name
  --write-only          write fixture files without rendering; attach llmb-
                        watch separately
  --cleanup             remove fixture directories after replay
  --screen {auto,normal,scroll}
  --json
